environment.description: Go service deployed on a bare EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No WAF, no reverse proxy with CORS enforcement. SameSite cookie attribute set to 'None' for cross-domain SSO compatibility. Service listens on port 8080, NLB forwards TCP directly. Rotation interval set to default 60 seconds via ROTATION_INTERVAL_SEC=60 env var.

config.cors_policy: none (handled by application - which allows all origins)
